data.action: 趴在池边，湿发贴着肩颈
data.description: 私人风吕热气蒸腾的石砌池边，艾雅法拉整个人趴在光滑的池石上，湿漉漉的卷发紧贴着纤弱白皙的肩颈，羊耳因水温而泛着红晕。她微红着脸回头看你——「前辈……水温好舒服。能麻烦前辈帮我把背上够不到的地方轻轻揉一揉吗？」
data.lighting: 斜入的冷月光照亮水汽和贴肩湿发，木篱边的矮灯在水面落下一小块暖光
data.nsfwProse: She is wrapped only in a damp white bath towel clinging tightly across her chest and dipping into the hot spring water, leaving her wet shoulders and collarbone bare.
data.promptProse: At a secluded spring in Terra at night, Eyjafjalla rests both forearms on the uneven slate at the edge of the pool. She glances over her shoulder, wet curls clinging to her neck and the white bath wrap touching the water. Use a horizontal side view at the height of the stone rim so the wet rock, her elbows and the pool line meet in the same plane. Moonlight picks out the steam above the darker water. A small amber lantern near the cedar privacy screen casts a broken reflection across the pool.
data.title: 艾雅法拉 · 私汤
data.animaCaption: Resting both forearms on the rough stone rim of the private hot spring, she glances back over her wet bare shoulder with a warm blush as damp curls cling to her neck. Her wet white bath wrap dips into the steaming water where moonlight and a small lantern reflect.
